summary: Read distinct coin denominations and a target amount. The denomination count runs from 1 to 300, each denomination runs from 1 to 5000, and amount runs from 0 to 5000. You may take as many coins as you want of each denomination. Count the combinations whose chosen denominations add up to exactly amount, and write that count. A combination records only how many coins of each denomination are used, not the sequence of picking them. Write 0 when no combination reaches the amount. The count fits in a signed 32 bit integer. When amount is 0, using no coins counts as one combination.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
